description: Panneaux double sens cyclable de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Panneau double sens cyclable sur le territoire de Nantes Métropole Localisation des panneaux de double sens cyclable. Ce panneau indique l’entrée dans une rue à double sens cyclable et indique que des cyclistes peuvent arriver en face. Un double-sens cyclable (DSC) est une voie de circulation à double sens dont l’un est réservé aux cyclistes. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are vélo, cycle, panneau. The portal shows 618 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
